headings.text: What actually matters in a washing machine under ₹25,000
Top load vs front load: the real difference

cta.headline: Hard water in your area?
cta.sub: Most front-load washers need hard water treatment. We ranked each model for hard water compatibility.

faq.q: Top load vs front load — which is better?
faq.a: Front load uses less water (40% less), washes better, and gentler on clothes. Top load is cheaper, faster, and easier to add clothes mid-cycle. For Indian families washing daily, front load is better for water-scarce cities.
Single/couple: 6-6.5kg. Small family (3-4): 7-7.5kg. Joint family (5+): 8-9kg. Most Indian homes need 7kg.

faq.q: Do I need a separate dryer?
faq.a: In Indian climate, dryers aren't usually needed. Front-loaders can spin-dry at 1000-1200 RPM which removes most water. A separate dryer is only worth it if you have heavy rains for 4+ months.
